versions.changelog:
Initial release of LDM Deliverability Check for OpenClaw agents:

- Provides preflight inbox placement and deliverability checks for outbound email campaigns.
- Evaluates spam/junk risk, authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), content issues, and compliance before send.
- Enforces a default minimum inbox placement threshold (70%) and recommends fixes on failure.
- Requires LDM API key setup; prompts for configuration if missing.
- Outlines clear agent workflow and result reporting for safe, effective outbound email sending.
